description.p: Hourglass Linux is a native Avalonia-based port of the Hourglass timer, focused on fast countdown entry, visible remaining time, saved timers, audio alerts, desktop notifications, and Linux desktop integration.
First stable Linux release with a self-contained x86_64 AppImage validated on Ubuntu, Fedora, and Arch GNOME Wayland desktops.
Add a reproducible, checksummed x86_64 AppImage release artifact.
Defer Unity launcher desktop-progress discovery until after the first window request.
Add per-service startup diagnostics for Linux desktop investigation.
Add opt-in startup diagnostics for Linux desktop investigation.
Select software rendering for X11 without native DRI3 probing.
Use a standalone XCB connection when checking DRI3 availability.
Select software rendering when the X server does not support DRI3.
Improved renderer fallback for Linux virtual-machine environments.
First public beta release with a self-contained Linux archive and checksum verification.
Initial Linux packaging prototype for local release validation.
